A '''message disk''' was a kind of [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that could convey a message. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Head of State [[Burr Nolyds]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destructing]] message disk that was left in his [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]] [[Burr Nolyds's chambers|chambers]] by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Executor]] [[Nom Anor]].
